title: Cost-aware Codex routing and recurring external PR intake
body:
WU088 task routing now uses 5.6 Luna for repetitive work, 5.6 Terra for ordinary coding, 6.1 Sol coordination with bounded 6 Sol/Luna workers, and Astra xhigh review/research or supported-client ultra for hard blockers. Official standalone profiles and project custom-agent files are installed; explicit launcher flags prevent silent route substitution.

A deterministic 6-hour PR watcher captures exact-head metadata with additive update history. New reviews invalidate previous dispositions while preserving scoped source-adoption evidence; verified findings are integrated at subsequent authorized work sessions. No unattended merges or scientific reruns.

Validation: seven routing/state tests; eight profile loaders; actual cwd config/read confirms Terra medium and child cap3; live polls show37open then0changed, no model calls; independent Astra xhigh scoped PASS. Prior195 PHYS07 core files match manifest. Provider response admission and future cron ticks are not claimed tested.

title: PHYS08: weighted photo cooling and HH source competition
body:
## Why
NCP PHYS07 preserved a directional witness as OPEN because its per-node heat condition fails at node 32, even though aggregate source directions can still be strictly cooling.

## What changes
Adds a separate PHYS08 research package with the weighted balance B = p v_w − w(v_x + fhat v_y1 + 2 fhat v_y2), derived from the same fixed-coefficient source. Exact rational postprocessing of all 33×3 signed rate enclosures certifies cooling and source-level HH/photo competition for full and same-COMMON first-half, separately for physical P_N and birth derivative P_M. Original node32 OPEN outputs and all tails remain unchanged.

Includes source provenance, captured inputs, exact outputs, an independently reviewed Rust scalar gate candidate, golden fixtures, a strict output consumer, bounded NCP wrapper and an attachment-free handoff.

## Evidence and scope
Independent noncreator decision: PROMOTE_SCOPED. Corrected Python reference passed in 0.368 s; first reflected-division implementation failure, source snapshot and targeted correction are preserved. 294 assertions cover four source-role cases and seven semantic cases, yielding 11 golden fixtures. No source/provider/solver or historical scientific replay.

Rust and the NCP wrapper/consumer are READY_NOT_RUN because rustc/cargo are absent on the research host. Native root/U/V/W/I, finite energy interaction, carry/paired/time/continuum, full49 and production remain OPEN. Dual-backup identities will be attached in a separate delivery commit; no merge or runtime installation is performed.

title: [HH PHYS07] Source C² domain and reference mixed response
body:
## 왜 필요한가

PHYS06 NCP의 energy/uniform/mixed/finite/paired adapter 구현은 완료됐지만, 실제 소스의 전체 상태·매개변수 영역과 C² 근거가 연결되지 않았다. 이번 연구는 그 빈칸을 source-specific reference family에서 계산하고 다음 NCP source producer 작업을 고정한다.

## 변경과 결과

- 최신 NCP head `65a36e255aa6d9911e23a9b5ced18d8a9f507606`의 선택한 원본 소스·실행·수정 이력과 COMMON seed를 고정했다.
- FT03 + LCS91 HH + reduced photo의 실제 source AST를 112-bit directed rational interval/second Jet로 구현했다. Transport는 명시된 isotropic analytic chart, scalar/provider는 correctly-rounded reference leaves다.
- `X=[.90,.93]×[.29,.31]×[.59,.61]×[13,14]`, `Theta=[0,1]^2`의 C² open neighborhood와 full/first-half source value/Jacobian/Hessian 포함을 얻었다.
- Strict Banach 포함과 고정 네 항 Neumann 다항식 + 엄밀한 tail로 해당 reference family의 unique-in-X root, mixed derivative 및 finite rectangle interaction을 증명했다. HII interaction은 음수, thermal w와 temperature interaction은 양수다. Gas thermal+ionization energy interaction의 부호는 OPEN이다.
- Native stored interval input·direction/libm/PreBE tuple binding을 다음 NCP 작업으로 넘기는 handoff/tasks/return template를 포함했다. 과거 source/ledger를 덮어쓰지 않고 새 연구 directory를 추가한다.

## 검증과 범위

새 실행 네 개가 첫 시도에서 통과했다: primitive/Jet 324 assertions, 두 stage의 whole/centre source 계산 각 2회, 저장된 export 분석 122 assertions. 총 bounded child 경과시간은 약 7.45초였다. 실행 전후 결박한 code/input bytes는 같고 첫 stdout/stderr/exit/resource/hash를 모두 보존했다. 독립 reviewer는 후보나 테스트를 생성하지 않았으며 정적 source/proof 검토와 실제 로그 판독으로 최종 범위를 판정했다.

실제 native source callback/PreBE/endpoint/BE point/native root producer/IVP/heavy atomic/과거 suite 실행은 이번 연구에 없다. Reference root/W/I를 실제 native 값으로 옮기지 않았다. Carried second-half, actual full-versus-two-half defect 및 time/continuum remainder는 미해결이다. 기존 NCP의 per-first-target binary hashes=null과 최종 widening 후 target 재실행 없음도 그대로 기록했다.

전체 보고서와 독립 판정은 `research/r31ao_unequal_ladder/hh_phys07_source_domain_20261011_v1/`에 있다. 실제 core/archive/Drive/Dropbox identity와 첨부 없는 시작 안내는 나중의 additive delivery directory에서 결박한다.
